Functional description

The diagnostic socket R10 is supplied directly by the battery at pin 16 by the line protected by fuse F10 of the junction unit B1 .Pins 4 and 5 are earthed.

The pins are connected to the ABS control unit M50 (pin 11) E7020 .

Pin 3 is connected to Air Bag control unit M60 (pin 6 of connector A) See E7030 AIRBAG .

Pin 11 is connected to alarm control unit M30 (pin 6 of connector A) and remote control receiver M35 (pin 2) E7015 .

Pin 8 is connected to Code control unit M20 (pin 5) E7010 .

Functional description

This unit M19 also uses - from pin 15 - the diagnostic line L, which is connected to pin 15 of R10 . E5030
